title: Fall 2026 Workshop (Oct 23–26)
cost_text: $500 per session. Check or cash accepted.
bring: Bisque-fired pots or greenware; terra sigillata available for purchase on-site
summary: A 2.5-day weekend workshop in October covering American raku, naked raku, pit firing, barrel firing, ferric chloride, and saggar techniques. Limit of 7 participants for personalized instruction. Currently on waitlist.
how_to_join: Join the waitlist via the signup form on the workshop page.
source_quote: Oct 23 - 26 SOLD OUT! Join the waitlist below.
evidence_sentence: Fall 2026 workshop includes pit firing and barrel firings in homemade barrel kilns, with saggar and ferric chloride techniques.
evidence_quote: pit firing and barrel firings in homemade barrel kilns
